rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Infectious Diseases Prevention Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended May 8, 2006; Feb. 5, 2008; Feb. 14, 2014>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention of Contagious Animal Diseases and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended May 8, 2006; Feb. 5, 2008; Feb. 14, 2014>

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Type 2 and Type 3 Infectious Diseases of Livestock, etc.) ① The term “ infectious diseases of livestock prescribed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 2, subparagraph 2, subparagraph (b) of the “Infectious Diseases of Livestock Prevention Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means Theileriosis (Theileriosis, applicable only to Theileriosis parva and Anulata), Babesiosis (Babesiosis, applicable only to Babesiosis visemina and Bobis), Anaplasmosis (Anaplasmosis, applicable only to Anaplasma marginale), duck viral hepatitis, duck viral enteritis, horse West Nile fever, swine influenza (applicable only to H5 or H7 serotype viruses and novel influenza A (H1N1) virus), and sacbrood disease. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Aug. 21, 2009; Dec. 30, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 14, 2014>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Type 2 and Type 3 Infectious Diseases of Livestock, etc.) ① The term “infectious diseases of livestock prescribed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 2, subparagraph 2, subparagraph (b) of the “Act on the Prevention of Contagious Animal Diseases” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means Theileriosis (Theileriosis, applicable only to Theileriosis parva and Anulata), Babesiosis (Babesiosis, applicable only to Babesiosis visemina and Bobis), Anaplasmosis (Anaplasmosis, applicable only to Anaplasma marginale), duck viral hepatitis, duck viral enteritis, horse West Nile fever, swine influenza (applicable only to H5 or H7 serotype viruses and novel influenza A (H1N1) virus), and sacbrood disease. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Aug. 21, 2009; Dec. 30, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 14, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ② In Article 2, subparagraph 2, item ( c) of the Act , “infectious diseases of livestock prescribed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” means bovine infectious rhinotracheitis, bovine leukosis (only endemic bovine leukosis), bovine leptospirosis, porcine infectious gastroenteritis, porcine erysipelas, porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome, porcine epidemic diarrhea, porcine atrophic rhinitis, pheasant encephalomyelitis, porcine infectious laryngotracheitis, porcine infectious bronchitis, Marek's disease, porcine infectious cyst disease, rabbit hemorrhagic disease, rabbit mucomatosis, and tularemia. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Dec. 30, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 14, 2021>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 2, subparagraph 2, item (c) of the Act , “infectious diseases of livestock prescribed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” means bovine infectious rhinotracheitis, bovine leukosis (only endemic bovine leukosis), bovine leptospirosis, porcine infectious gastroenteritis, porcine erysipelas, porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome, porcine epidemic diarrhea, porcine atrophic rhinitis, pheasant encephalomyelitis, porcine infectious laryngotracheitis, porcine infectious bronchitis, Marek's disease, porcine infectious cyst disease, rabbit hemorrhagic disease, rabbit mucomatosis, and tularemia. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Dec. 30, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 14, 2021>

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Surveillance of Infectious Livestock Diseases) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Mayor of a Special City, a Consolidated Special City, a Metropolitan City, a Governor of a Province, or a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Governor of a City/Province”), and the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, a Mayor (including the Administrative Mayor of a Special Self-Governing Province), a County Head, or a District Head (the District Head refers to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/County Head/District Head ”) may conduct surveillance regarding infectious livestock diseases in order to efficiently establish and implement the duties prescribed in Article 3 , Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1, 2, and 5 of the Act, and to carry out duties for prompt disease control measures. <Amended Feb. 5, 2008; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; May 1, 2018; Sep. 29, 2026>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Surveillance of Infectious Livestock Diseases) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Mayor of a Special City, a Consolidated Special City, a Metropolitan City, a Governor of a Province, or a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Governor of a City/Province”), and the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, a Mayor (including the Administrative Mayor of a Special Self-Governing Province), a County Head, or a District Head (the District Head refers to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/County Head/District Head”) may conduct surveillance regarding infectious livestock diseases in order to efficiently establish and implement the duties prescribed in Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1, 2, and 5 of the Act, and to carry out duties for prompt disease control measures. <Amended Feb. 5, 2008; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; May 1, 2018; Sep. 29, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 검역본부장: 제2항에 따른 정보공개 내용 및 범위에 대한 최신 정보를 농림축산검역본부의 홈페이지에 공개하고, 농림축산식품부장관, 시ㆍ도지사(특별자치시장을 포함한다. 이하 제3조의5제2항ㆍ제3항, 제4조제3항, 제11조제1항ㆍ제2항, 제45조의3제2항, 제46조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 및 같은 조 제2항 각 호 외의 부분에서 같다) 및 축산관련 단체의 장에게 정보통신망 등을 이용하여 통보한다. 이 경우 시ㆍ도지사는 검역본부장으로부터 통보받은 정보를 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency: He/She shall disclose the latest information regarding the contents and scope of information disclosure pursuant to Paragraph 2 on the website of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency and notify the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the mayors/governors of cities/provinces (including mayors of special autonomous cities; hereinafter the same applies in Article 3-5, Paragraphs 2 and 3, Article 4, Paragraph 3, Article 11 Paragraphs 1 and 2 , Article 45-3 Paragraph 2 , the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 46 Paragraph 1 and the part other than the subparagraphs of Paragraph 2 of the same article ), and the heads of livestock-related organizations using information and communication networks, etc. In this case, the mayors/governors of cities/provinces shall notify the mayors/county heads/district heads of the information received from the Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency.

rows.source_ko: 2. 농림축산식품부장관, 관계 행정기관의 장, 시ㆍ도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장: 제2항에 따른 정보 공개 내용ㆍ범위와 법 제3조의2제4항에 따른 공개 대상을 홈페이지, 정보통신망 또는 기관 소식지 등에 공개한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, heads of relevant administrative agencies, governors of cities and provinces, mayors, county heads, and district heads: They shall disclose the contents and scope of information disclosure pursuant to Paragraph 2 and the subjects of disclosure pursuant to Article 3-2 Paragraph 4 of the Act on their websites, information and communications networks, or institutional newsletters, etc.

[This Article was newly added on July 25, 2011.]
[Moved from Article 3-2 on Feb. 14, 2014.]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의4(국가가축방역통합정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영) ① 다음 각 호의 업무는 법 제3조의3제1항에 따른 국가가축방역통합정보시스템(이하 “방역정보시스템”이라 한다)을 통하여 처리하여야 한다. 다만, 방역정보시스템이 정상적으로 운영되지 아니하는 경우에는 다른 방법으로 우선 처리한 후, 방역정보시스템이 정상적으로 운영되면 그 처리 내용을 방역정보시스템에 입력하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 1., 2020. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-4 (Establishment and Operation of the National Integrated Animal Disease Control Information System) ① The tasks set forth in each of the following subparagraphs shall be processed through the National Integrated Animal Disease Control Information System pursuant to Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Disease Control Information System”). However, if the Disease Control Information System is not operating normally, the matters shall be processed first by another method, and once the Disease Control Information System is operating normally, the details of such processing shall be entered into the Disease Control Information System. <Amended May 1, 2018; May 28, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제3조제1항제1호에 따른 가축전염병의 예방 및 조기 발견ㆍ신고 체계 구축에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the prevention of livestock infectious diseases and the establishment of a system for early detection and reporting pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제3조제1항제2호에 따른 가축전염병별 긴급방역대책의 수립ㆍ시행에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the establishment and implementation of emergency quarantine measures for each livestock infectious disease pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제3조제1항제6호에 따른 가축방역에 관한 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 조사ㆍ연구에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Duties concerning the collection, analysis, investigation, and research of information regarding livestock disease control pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 6 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제3조제1항제8호에 따른 살처분ㆍ소각ㆍ매몰ㆍ화학적 처리 등 가축방역에 따른 주변환경의 오염방지 및 사후관리 대책 수립ㆍ시행에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the establishment and implementation of measures for the prevention of environmental pollution and post-management resulting from livestock disease control, such as culling, incineration, burial, and chemical treatment, pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 8 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제12조제2항에 따른 병성감정 결과의 보고
rows.text_en: 5. Reporting of the results of the pathological examination pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 법 제14조에 따른 가축전염병 병원체의 분리보고ㆍ신고 및 보존ㆍ관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Duties concerning the isolation, reporting, notification, and preservation and management of pathogens of livestock infectious diseases pursuant to Article 14 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 법 제17조의4제2항에 따른 차량출입정보의 수집ㆍ유지ㆍ관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Duties regarding the collection, maintenance, and management of vehicle entry and exit information pursuant to Article 17-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 8. 제15조제4항에 따른 역학조사 결과의 제출
rows.text_en: 8. Submission of epidemiological investigation results pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 4

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제3조의3제3항에 따라 축산관계자 주소, 축산 관련 시설의 소재지, 가축과 그 생산물의 이동 현황 및 다음 각 호의 정보에 대하여 방역정보시스템에 입력을 명할 수 있다. <신설 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 3-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may order the input of the addresses of persons involved in the livestock industry, the locations of livestock-related facilities, the status of movement of livestock and their products, and the information set forth in each of the following subparagraphs into the disease control information system. <Newly added July 1, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「축산법」 제2조제9호에 따른 가축거래상인 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Status of livestock traders pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 9 of the Livestock Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 실시한 방역 관련 점검 결과
rows.text_en: 2. Results of disease control inspections conducted by mayors, county heads, and district heads

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 가축전염병의 확산을 방지하기 위하여 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 정보
rows.text_en: 3. Other information determined and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs to prevent the spread of infectious animal diseases

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제3조의3제3항에 따라 정보 입력의 명을 받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 입력한 사항이 변경되었을 때에는 방역정보시스템에 즉시 변경된 내용을 반영해야 한다. <신설 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ A Mayor, County Governor, or District Head who has received an order to input information pursuant to Article 3-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall immediately reflect the changed contents in the disease control information system when the entered matters are changed. <Newly added July 1, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 방역정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영 등에 필요한 사항은 검역본부장이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the establishment and operation, etc. of the disease control information system shall be determined and announced by the Head of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency. <Amended July 1, 2019>
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 14, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의5(중점방역관리지구 지정 등) ① 법 제3조의4제1항에 따라 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제4조제1항에 따른 중앙가축방역심의회(이하 “심의회”라 한다)의 심의를 거쳐 다음 각 호의 지역을 중점방역관리지구로 지정한다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-5 (Designation of Priority Disease Control Management Districts, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 3-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall designate the areas in each of the following subparagraphs as Priority Disease Control Management Districts following deliberation by the Central Animal Disease Control Council (hereinafter referred to as the “Council”) pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act. <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고병원성 조류인플루엔자가 발생할 위험이 높은 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 지역
rows.text_en: 1. Areas falling under any of the following subparagraphs with a high risk of highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks

rows.source_ko: 가. 고병원성 조류인플루엔자가 최근 5년간 2회 이상 발생한 지역. 이 경우 고병원성 조류인플루엔자가 발생하여 해를 넘겨 지속되는 때에는 1회로 본다.
rows.text_en: a. Regions where highly pathogenic avian influenza has occurred two or more times in the past five years. In this case, if highly pathogenic avian influenza occurs and persists into the following year, it shall be counted as one occurrence.

rows.source_ko: 나. 닭, 오리, 칠면조, 거위, 타조, 메추리, 꿩, 기러기(이하 “가금”이라 한다) 사육농가 수가 반경 500미터 이내 10호 이상 또는 1킬로미터 이내 20호 이상인 지역
rows.text_en: b. Areas where the number of farms raising chickens, ducks, turkeys, geese, ostriches, quails, pheasants, and wild geese (hereinafter referred to as “poultry”) is 10 or more within a radius of 500 meters or 20 or more within a radius of 1 kilometer.

rows.source_ko: 다. 철새도래지 반경 10킬로미터 이내 지역
rows.text_en: c. Areas within a 10-kilometer radius of migratory bird habitats

rows.source_ko: 2. 아프리카돼지열병이 발생할 위험이 높은 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 지역
rows.text_en: 2. Any of the following areas with a high risk of African Swine Fever outbreak

rows.source_ko: 가. 아프리카돼지열병이 최근 5년간 1회 이상 발생한 지역
rows.text_en: a. Regions where African Swine Fever has occurred at least once in the last five years

rows.source_ko: 나. 야생멧돼지 등 가축전염병 특정매개체 또는 물ㆍ토양 등 환경에서 아프리카돼지열병 바이러스가 검출된 지역
rows.text_en: b. Areas where the African Swine Fever virus has been detected in specific vectors of livestock infectious diseases, such as wild boars, or in the environment, such as water and soil.

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 제1종 가축전염병이 발생할 위험이 높은 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 지역
rows.text_en: 3. Other areas falling under any of the following subparagraphs where there is a high risk of outbreaks of Class 1 infectious animal diseases

rows.source_ko: 가. 제1종 가축전염병이 최근 5년간 2회 이상 발생한 지역
rows.text_en: a. Areas where Class 1 livestock infectious diseases have occurred two or more times in the last five years

rows.source_ko: 나. 가축 사육농가 수가 반경 500미터 이내 10호 이상 또는 1킬로미터 이내 20호 이상인 지역
rows.text_en: b. Areas where the number of livestock farms is 10 or more within a radius of 500 meters or 20 or more within a radius of 1 kilometer

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제3조의4제2항에 따라 농림축산식품부장관은 중점방역관리지구에 대하여 가축 및 가축전염병 특정매개체에 대한 임상ㆍ환경 모니터링 검사 및 그 밖에 가축전염병 예방을 위해 필요한 사항에 관한 조치계획을 수립하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 통보해야 한다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 3-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall formulate a plan of measures regarding clinical and environmental monitoring inspections of livestock and specific vectors of livestock infectious diseases and other matters necessary for the prevention of livestock infectious diseases with respect to Key Disease Control Zones, and notify the Mayors and Governors of Provinces and Cities. <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 조치계획을 통보받은 시ㆍ도지사는 1개월 이내에 관할 중점방역관리지구에 대한 조치계획을 수립하고 이를 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보해야 하며, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 조치계획을 통보받은 날부터 1개월 이내에 관할 중점방역관리지구에 대한 조치계획을 수립하여 시행해야 한다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ A City or Provincial Governor who has been notified of the action plan pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall formulate an action plan for the priority disease control district under their jurisdiction within one month and notify the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head thereof; and the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall formulate and implement an action plan for the priority disease control district under their jurisdiction within one month from the date of receiving the notification of the action plan. <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제3조의4제3항에 따라 중점방역관리지구에서 가축 사육이나 축산 관련 영업(돼지에 관한 사육이나 축산 관련 영업은 제외한다)을 하려는 자는 다음 각 호의 소독설비 및 방역시설을 갖추어야 한다. <개정 2017. 9. 25., 2018. 5. 1., 2020. 10. 7., 2024. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to Article 3-4, Paragraph 3 of the Act , any person who intends to raise livestock or engage in livestock-related business (excluding the raising of pigs or livestock-related business) in a Key Disease Control District shall equip themselves with the disinfection equipment and disease control facilities specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 25, 2017; May 1, 2018; Oct. 7, 2020; Apr. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방역복 착용 등을 위한 전실(前室, 농장 또는 축사의 입구에 방역복 착용 및 신발소독조 설치 등을 위하여 설치한 소독설비를 말한다. 이하 같다)
rows.text_en: 1. Anteroom for wearing protective clothing, etc. (Anteroom, refers to a disinfection facility installed at the entrance of a farm or livestock barn for the purpose of wearing protective clothing and installing a shoe disinfection tank, etc. The same applies hereinafter.)

rows.source_ko: 2. 울타리 또는 담장
rows.text_en: 2. Fence or wall

rows.source_ko: 3. 농장 내 출입차량 세척시설 및 차량의 바퀴ㆍ흙받기를 소독할 수 있는 고압분무기
rows.text_en: 3. Vehicle washing facilities for entering and exiting the farm and high-pressure sprayers capable of disinfecting vehicle wheels and mudguards

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제3조의4제3항에 따라 중점방역관리지구에서 돼지에 관한 사육이나 축산 관련 영업을 하려는 자는 별표 1의2에 따른 소독설비 및 방역시설을 갖추어야 한다. <신설 2020. 10. 7., 2024. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Pursuant to Article 3-4, Paragraph 3 of the Act , any person intending to raise pigs or engage in livestock-related business in a Priority Disease Control District shall equip disinfection facilities and disease control facilities in accordance with Annex 1-2 . <Newly added Oct. 7, 2020; Apr. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제3조의4제6항에 따라 다음 각 호에 해당하는 경우 심의회의 심의를 거쳐 중점방역관리지구의 지정을 해제할 수 있다. <개정 2020. 5. 28., 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Pursuant to Article 3-4, Paragraph 6 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may lift the designation of a Key Disease Control Management District following deliberation by the Council in cases falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 28, 2020; Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제1항제1호가목에 해당하여 중점방역관리지구로 지정된 이후 3년간 고병원성 조류인플루엔자의 발생이 없는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where there have been no outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza for three years since being designated as a Key Disease Control District in accordance with Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, Item (a).

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1항제1호나목에 해당하여 중점방역관리지구로 지정된 이후 가금 사육농가 수가 감소하여 중점방역관리지구의 지정 기준을 충족하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where the number of poultry farms decreases after being designated as a Key Disease Control District under Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, Item (b), and thus the criteria for designation as a Key Disease Control District are no longer met

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1항제1호다목에 해당하여 중점방역관리지구로 지정된 이후 철새도래지에서 제외된 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where a site is excluded from migratory bird habitats after being designated as a priority disease control management district in accordance with Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, Item (c).

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1항제2호가목에 해당하여 중점방역관리지구로 지정된 이후 3년간 아프리카돼지열병의 발생이 없는 경우
rows.text_en: 4. In cases where there have been no outbreaks of African Swine Fever for three years since being designated as a Key Disease Control District in accordance with Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item (a).

rows.source_ko: 5. 제1항제2호나목에 해당하여 중점방역관리지구로 지정된 이후 3년간 야생멧돼지 등 가축전염병 특정매개체 또는 물ㆍ토양 등 환경에서 아프리카돼지열병 바이러스가 검출되지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 5. In cases where the African Swine Fever virus is not detected in specific vectors of livestock infectious diseases, such as wild boars, or in the environment, such as water and soil, for three years following designation as a Key Disease Control Management District in accordance with Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item (b).

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제1항부터 제6항까지의 규정에 따른 세부사항은 가축전염병별로 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Detailed matters pursuant to the provisions of Paragraphs 1 through 6 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for each infectious animal disease . <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(사육제한 명령 등) ① 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 명령을 하려는 경우에는 미리 해당 가축의 소유자 또는 관리자(이하 “소유자등”이라 한다)에게 서면 또는 전자문서로 그 사실을 알려야 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Order to Restrict Rearing, etc.) ① When a Mayor, County Governor, or District Head intends to issue an order falling under any of the following subparagraphs, they shall notify the owner or manager of the relevant livestock (hereinafter referred to as “owner, etc.”) of such fact in writing or by electronic document. <Amended Apr. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제3조의4제5항에 따라 중점방역관리지구 내에서 가축사육제한 명령을 하려는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where an order to restrict livestock breeding is to be issued within a Key Disease Control Zone pursuant to Article 3-4, Paragraph 5 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제19조제4항(법 제28조 및 제28조의2에서 준용하는 경우를 포함한다)에 따라 가축사육시설의 폐쇄명령 또는 가축사육제한 명령을 하려는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where an order to close a livestock breeding facility or an order to restrict livestock breeding is to be issued pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 4 of the Act ( including cases where it is applied mutatis mutandis under Articles 28 and 28-2 of the Act ).

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제1호 및 제2호에 따른 명령은 별지 제1호서식에 따른다. <개정 2024. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The orders under Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 and 2 shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto . <Amended Apr. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(특별자치시장은 제외한다)은 제1항제1호 및 제2호에 따른 명령을 한 경우에는 해당 가축사육시설의 명칭, 소재지, 가축의 소유자, 명령일자 및 이행기간 등을 시ㆍ도지사에게 통보하고, 시ㆍ도지사는 해당 사항을 농림축산식품부장관 및 다른 시ㆍ도지사에게 통보하여야 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ When a Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (excluding the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City) issues an order pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 and 2, they shall notify the Governor of a City or Province of the name and location of the relevant livestock breeding facility, the owner of the livestock, the date of the order, and the period of compliance, etc., and the Governor of a City or Province shall notify the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and other Governors of such matters. <Amended Apr. 23, 2024>
[This Article Newly Inserted May 1, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(심의회의 구성 및 운영) ①심의회는 위원장 1명과 부위원장 2인을 포함한 100명 이내의 위원으로 성별을 고려하여 구성한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Composition and Operation of the Council) ① The Council shall be composed of no more than 100 members, including one Chairperson and two Vice-Chairpersons, with consideration for gender. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ②위원장은 농림축산식품부 소속의 축산 관련 업무를 담당하는 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원(직무등급이 가등급에 해당하는 공무원에 한정한다)이 되고, 부위원장은 농림축산식품부 소속의 고위공무원단에 속하는 가축방역 또는 검역업무를 담당하는 공무원과 위원중에서 호선한 1명으로 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2008. 12. 31., 2009. 4. 30., 2011. 7. 25., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson shall be a public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service under the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs responsible for livestock-related affairs (limited to public officials with a job grade of Grade A), and the Vice Chairperson shall be one person elected by mutual consent from among the members and a public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service under the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs responsible for livestock disease control or quarantine affairs. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Dec. 31, 2008; Apr. 30, 2009; Jul. 25, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③위원장은 심의회를 대표하고, 심의회의 업무를 총괄한다. <개정 2015. 12. 21., 2019. 8. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Chairperson represents the Council and oversees the Council's affairs. <Amended Dec. 21, 2015; Aug. 26, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ④위원장이 부득이한 사유로 직무를 수행할 수 없는 때에는 호선된 부위원장, 농림축산식품부 소속의 고위공무원단에 속하는 가축방역 또는 검역업무를 담당하는 공무원 및 위원장이 미리 지명한 위원의 순으로 그 직무를 대행한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2009. 4. 30., 2011. 7. 25., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ In the event that the Chairperson is unable to perform their duties due to unavoidable circumstances, the duties shall be performed in the following order: the Vice Chairperson elected by mutual consent, public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs responsible for livestock disease control or quarantine, and the members designated in advance by the Chairperson. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Apr. 30, 2009; Jul. 25, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ⑤심의회의 위원은 수의(獸醫)ㆍ축산ㆍ의료ㆍ환경 분야 등에 학식과 경험이 풍부한 자중에서 농림축산식품부장관이 임명 또는 위촉한다. 이 경우 시민단체(「비영리민간단체 지원법」 제2조의 규정에 의한 비영리민간단체를 말한다)가 추천하는 위원이 1명 이상 포함되도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2006. 5. 8., 2008. 3. 3., 2008. 12. 31., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Members of the Deliberation Council shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs from among those with extensive knowledge and experience in the fields of veterinary medicine, livestock, medical care, environment, etc. In this case, at least one member recommended by a civic group (referring to a non-profit private organization as stipulated in Article 2 of the Act on Support for Non-Profit Private Organizations ) shall be included. <Amended May 8, 2006; March 3, 2008; December 31, 2008; March 23, 2013; December 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑥위원중 공무원이 아닌 위원의 임기는 2년으로 하되, 연임할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The term of office for members who are not public officials shall be two years, and they may serve consecutive terms.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 위원회에는 질병ㆍ축종 등에 따른 전문분야 심의회를 둘 수 있다. <신설 2008. 12. 31., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Committee may establish specialized deliberation councils for diseases, livestock species, etc. <Newly added Dec. 31, 2008; Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 전문분야별 심의회의 회의는 제6조를 준용한다. <신설 2008. 12. 31., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The provisions of Article 6 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the meetings of the deliberation councils by specialized field . <Newly added Dec. 31, 2008; Dec. 21, 2015>
[Title amended Dec. 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(심의회의 회의) ①위원장은 심의회의 회의를 소집하고, 그 의장이 된다. <개정 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Meetings of the Deliberation Council) ① The Chairperson shall convene meetings of the Deliberation Council and preside over them. <Amended Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ②위원장은 농림축산식품부장관 또는 위원 3분의 1 이상의 요구가 있는 때에는 지체없이 회의를 소집하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson shall convene a meeting without delay upon the request of the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or of at least one-third of the members. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 심의회의 회의는 위원장, 부위원장 및 위원장이 회의 시마다 지정하는 위원을 포함하여 30명 이내로 구성한다. <개정 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ Meetings of the Deliberation Council shall be composed of no more than 30 members, including the Chairperson, the Vice Chairperson, and members designated by the Chairperson for each meeting. <Amended Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ④ 심의회는 제3항에 따른 구성원 과반수의 출석으로 개의(開議)하고, 출석위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다. <신설 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Council shall convene with the attendance of a majority of its members pursuant to Paragraph 3, and shall make decisions with the approval of a majority of the members present. <Newly added Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 심의회는 심의사항과 관련하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 관계인을 출석시켜 의견을 들을 수 있다. <신설 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ If the Council deems it necessary in relation to matters under deliberation, it may have relevant persons attend and hear their opinions. <Newly added Dec. 21, 2015>
[Title amended Dec. 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(위원의 해임 및 해촉) 농림축산식품부장관은 위원이 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 해당 위원을 해임 또는 해촉(解囑)할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Dismissal and Removal of Members) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may dismiss or remove a member if the member falls under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 심신장애로 인하여 직무를 수행할 수 없게 된 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where duties cannot be performed due to mental or physical disability

rows.source_ko: 2. 직무와 관련된 비위사실이 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of misconduct related to official duties

rows.source_ko: 3. 직무태만, 품위손상이나 그 밖의 사유로 인하여 위원으로 적합하지 아니하다고 인정되는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where a member is deemed unsuitable due to negligence of duty, damage to reputation, or other reasons

rows.source_ko: 4. 위원 스스로 직무를 수행하는 것이 곤란하다고 의사를 밝히는 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Cases where a member expresses that it is difficult to perform their duties.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(심의회의 간사 등) ①심의회에 간사 1인을 두되, 간사는 농림축산식품부 소속 공무원 중에서 가축방역 또는 검역업무를 담당하는 과장이 된다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2011. 7. 25., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Secretary, etc. of the Deliberation Council) ① One secretary shall be appointed to the Deliberation Council; the secretary shall be a division head in charge of livestock disease control or quarantine affairs from among public officials belonging to the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; July 25, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ②심의회에 출석한 위원에게는 예산의 범위안에서 수당과 여비 그 밖에 필요한 경비를 지급할 수 있다. 다만, 공무원인 위원이 그 소관업무와 직접 관련하여 심의회에 출석하는 경우에는 그러하지 아니하다. <개정 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② Members attending the Council may be paid allowances, travel expenses, and other necessary expenses within the limits of the budget. However, this shall not apply to members who are public officials attending the Council in direct relation to their assigned duties. <Amended Dec. 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③이 규칙에 규정된 사항 외에 심의회 및 전문분야별 심의회의 운영에 필요한 사항은 심의회의 의결을 거쳐 위원장이 정한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2015. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ Except for matters stipulated in these Rules, matters necessary for the operation of the Council and specialized councils shall be determined by the Chairperson following a resolution by the Council. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Dec. 21, 2015>
[Title amended Dec. 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(외국인 근로자 고용 신고 등) ① 법 제5조제3항 및 제10항에 따라 가축의 소유자등이 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 외국인 근로자 고용신고를 할 때에는 별지 제1호의2서식에 따른 외국인 근로자 고용신고서를 작성하여 제출하거나 팩스 또는 그 밖에 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 정하는 방법으로 신고할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Reporting of Employment of Foreign Workers, etc.) ① In accordance with Article 5, Paragraphs 3 and 10 of the Act , when an owner of livestock, etc. reports the employment of foreign workers to the competent Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, they may report by completing and submitting a report on the employment of foreign workers in accordance with Form No. 1-2 of the attached form, or by fax or other method determined by the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head. <Amended May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 가축의 소유자등으로부터 외국인 근로자의 고용신고를 받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신고사항을 별지 제1호의3서식에 따른 외국인 근로자 고용신고 관리대장에 기록하여 관리하고, 방역정보시스템에 신고사항을 입력하여야 하며, 분기별 1회 이상 외국인 근로자의 고용 여부를 확인하여 고용의 해지 등 변경 사항이 발생한 경우에는 방역정보시스템에 즉시 변경된 내용을 반영해야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 2. 14., 2018. 5. 1., 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② A Mayor, County Governor, or District Head who receives a report on the employment of a foreign worker from the owner of livestock, etc., shall record and manage the reported matters in the Foreign Worker Employment Report Management Register in accordance with Form No. 1-3 of the Attached Subparagraph, and enter the reported matters into the Quarantine Information System. Furthermore, they shall verify the employment status of foreign workers at least once per quarter, and if any changes occur, such as the termination of employment, they shall immediately reflect the changes in the Quarantine Information System. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 14, 2014; May 1, 2018; July 1, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 가축의 소유자등은 외국인 근로자를 고용하여 처음으로 가축사육시설에 들이는 경우 해당 외국인 근로자에 대하여 가축방역 관련 예방 교육 및 의류ㆍ신발ㆍ소지품 등에 대한 소독을 먼저 실시하여야 한다. 다만, 해당 외국인 근로자가 법 제9조제1항에 따른 가축위생방역 지원본부(이하 “방역본부”라 한다)에서 실시하는 교육과정을 이수한 경우에는 가축의 소유자등이 예방 교육을 실시한 것으로 본다. <개정 2026. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ When an owner, etc. of livestock hires a foreign worker and introduces them into a livestock breeding facility for the first time, they must first conduct preventive education related to livestock disease control and disinfect the worker's clothing, shoes, personal belongings, etc. However, if the foreign worker has completed the training course conducted by the Livestock Hygiene and Disease Control Support Headquarters pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Disease Control Headquarters”), the owner, etc. of livestock shall be deemed to have conducted the preventive education. <Amended Apr. 23, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 가축의 소유자등은 제3항에 따른 가축방역예방교육 실시 사항과 소독실시 내용을별지 제6호서식에 따른 소독실시기록부에 기록하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The owner of the livestock, etc., shall record the details of the livestock disease prevention education conducted pursuant to Paragraph 3 and the details of the disinfection conducted in the disinfection record book in accordance with Form No. 6 of the attached form.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 가축전염병의 예방 및 확산 방지를 위하여 필요한 경우에는 가축방역관 또는 소속 공무원 등에게 외국인 근로자를 고용한 농장을 방문해 가축의 소유자등의 외국인 근로자에 대한 예방 교육 및 소독 실시 여부를 확인하게 할 수 있다. <신설 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ If necessary for the prevention of infectious livestock diseases and the containment of their spread, the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may have a livestock quarantine officer or a public official under their jurisdiction visit a farm employing foreign workers to verify whether the livestock owner, etc. has conducted preventive education and disinfection for the foreign workers. <Newly added July 1, 2019>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 25, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의3(질문ㆍ검사ㆍ소독 고지 및 소독 등 실시) ① 검역본부장은 법 제5조제4항에 따라 질문ㆍ검사ㆍ소독에 관한 사항을 고지할 때 인터넷 홈페이지ㆍ안내방송ㆍ서면ㆍ문자메시지 또는 그 밖에 검역본부장이 정하는 방법으로 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-3 (Notification of Questioning, Inspection, and Disinfection, and Implementation of Disinfection, etc.) ① When the Head of the Quarantine and Inspection Agency provides notification of matters concerning questioning, inspection, and disinfection pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act , he/she shall do so via its website, public announcement, written document, text message, or any other method determined by the Head of the Quarantine and Inspection Agency. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 검역본부장은 법 제5조제5항 및 제6항에 따라 가축전염병 발생국가에서 입국하는 사람 등에 대하여 다음 각 호의 조치를 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2020. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency shall take the following measures with respect to persons, etc. entering from a country where an outbreak of livestock infectious disease has occurred, in accordance with Article 5 , Paragraphs 5 and 6 of the Act . <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; May 28, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 가축전염병 발생국가 체류 또는 경유 여부 및 가축사육시설 방문여부에 대한 질문 또는 확인과 검사
rows.text_en: 1. Questioning or verification and testing regarding stay in or transit through countries with outbreaks of livestock infectious diseases and visits to livestock breeding facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1호의 사실이 확인된 경우 제20조에 따른 소독 실시
rows.text_en: 2. If the facts under Subparagraph 1 are confirmed, carry out disinfection pursuant to Article 20

rows.source_ko: 3. 가축전염병발생국가에서 입국한 날부터 5일 이내에는 가축사육시설에 들어가지 않도록 방역교육 실시
rows.text_en: 3. Conduct disease prevention education to ensure that individuals do not enter livestock breeding facilities within 5 days of arrival from a country with an outbreak of livestock infectious diseases.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 25, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의4(가축의 소유자등의 범위 및 입국ㆍ출국 신고 등) ① 법 제5조제6항에 따른 질문ㆍ검사ㆍ소독 등 필요한 조치에 따르거나 입국ㆍ출국 사실 등을 신고하여야 하는 사람의 구체적인 범위는 다음 각 호와 같다. 이 경우 신고 대상자의 확인 방법 및 절차에 필요한 사항은 검역본부장이 정하여 고시할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 14., 2015. 12. 21., 2017. 5. 29., 2020. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-4 (Scope of Owners, etc. of Livestock and Reporting of Entry/Exit, etc.) ① The specific scope of persons required to comply with necessary measures, such as questioning, inspection, and disinfection pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 6 of the Act , or to report facts of entry/exit, etc., is as follows. In this case, the Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency may prescribe and announce matters necessary for the method and procedure for verifying persons subject to reporting. <Amended Feb. 14, 2014; Dec. 21, 2015; May 29, 2017; May 28, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 가축의 소유자등: 「축산법」 제2조에 따른 소, 산양, 면양, 돼지, 닭과 같은 법 시행규칙 제2조에 따른 사슴, 오리, 거위, 칠면조, 메추리를 사육하는 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Owners, etc. of livestock: Persons raising cattle, goats, sheep, pigs, and chickens pursuant to Article 2 of the Livestock Act , and deer, ducks, geese, turkeys, and quail pursuant to Article 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: 2. 가축의 소유자등에게 고용된 사람: 고용계약 체결 유ㆍ무와 상관없이 가축의 소유자등에게 사실상 노무를 제공하는 사람
rows.text_en: 2. Person employed by the owner of livestock, etc.: A person who actually provides labor to the owner of livestock, etc., regardless of whether an employment contract has been concluded.

rows.source_ko: 3. 동거가족: 제1호 또는 제2호에 해당하는 사람과 거소를 같이 하는 가족
rows.text_en: 3. Cohabiting family: Family members who share a residence with a person falling under Subparagraph 1 or 2.

rows.source_ko: 4. 수의사: 「수의사법」 제4조에 따른 수의사 면허를 받은 사람으로서 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람
rows.text_en: 4. Veterinarian: A person who has obtained a veterinarian license pursuant to Article 4 of the Veterinarian Act and falls under any of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 「수의사법」에 따른 동물병원 개설자 및 그에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: a. The founder of an animal hospital pursuant to the Veterinarian Act and persons employed thereby

rows.source_ko: 나. 「국가공무원법」 및 「지방공무원법」에 따른 공무원 중 수의ㆍ축산 관련 업무를 수행하는 공무원
rows.text_en: B. Public officials under the National Public Officials Act and the Local Public Officials Act who perform duties related to veterinary or livestock

rows.source_ko: 다. 「공중방역수의사에 관한 법률」에 따른 공중방역수의사
rows.text_en: C. Public health veterinarian pursuant to the Act on Public Health Veterinarians

rows.source_ko: 라. 「고등교육법」에 따른 수의학, 축산학 또는 동물자원학을 전공하는 대학의 교수, 부교수, 조교수, 강사 및 대학원에 재학중인 사람
rows.text_en: D. Professors, associate professors, assistant professors, lecturers, and graduate students majoring in veterinary medicine, animal science, or animal resources at universities pursuant to the Higher Education Act

rows.source_ko: 마. 제8조에 따른 축산관련 단체에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: E. Persons employed by livestock-related organizations pursuant to Article 8

rows.source_ko: 바. 「도시공원 및 녹지 등에 관한 법률」, 「자연공원법 시행령」 또는 「박물관 및 미술관 진흥법 시행령」에 따라 동물원에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: f. Persons employed by a zoo pursuant to the Act on Urban Parks and Green Spaces, etc. , the Enforcement Decree of the Natural Parks Act , or the Enforcement Decree of the Museum and Art Gallery Promotion Act.

rows.source_ko: 사. 「국립생태원의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따라 국립생태원에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: G. Persons employed by the National Institute of Ecology pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology
Ah. Deleted <May 29, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 5. 「축산법」 제17조에 따른 가축인공수정소 개설자와 그에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: 5. The operator of a livestock artificial insemination center pursuant to Article 17 of the Livestock Act and persons employed thereby

rows.source_ko: 6. 가축방역사: 법 제8조에 따라 가축방역사로 위촉된 사람
rows.text_en: 6. Animal Disease Control Officer: A person appointed as an Animal Disease Control Officer pursuant to Article 8 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 동물약품을 판매하는 사람: 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람과 그에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: 7. Persons selling veterinary drugs: Persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs and persons employed thereby

rows.source_ko: 가. 「동물용 의약품등 취급규칙」 제3조에 따른 동물약국 개설자
rows.text_en: a. Owner of an animal pharmacy pursuant to Article 3 of the "Rules on the Handling of Veterinary Medicines, etc."

rows.source_ko: 나. 「동물용 의약품등 취급규칙」제4조에 따른 동물용의약품제조업자
rows.text_en: B. Manufacturers of veterinary drugs pursuant to Article 4 of the "Rules on the Handling of Veterinary Drugs, etc."

rows.source_ko: 다. 「동물용 의약품등 취급규칙」제16조에 따른 동물용의약품수입판매업자
rows.text_en: C. Importers and distributors of veterinary drugs pursuant to Article 16 of the "Rules on the Handling of Veterinary Drugs, etc."

rows.source_ko: 라.「동물용 의약품등 취급규칙」 제20조에 따른 동물용의약품도매상 소유자
rows.text_en: D. Owner of a veterinary drug wholesaler pursuant to Article 20 of the "Rules on the Handling of Veterinary Drugs, etc."

rows.source_ko: 8. 사료를 판매하는 사람: 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람과 그에 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: 8. Persons selling feed: Persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs and persons employed thereby.

rows.source_ko: 가. 「사료관리법」 제8조에 따라 등록한 사료제조업자
rows.text_en: a. Feed manufacturers registered pursuant to Article 8 of the Feed Management Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「사료관리법」에 따른 판매업자
rows.text_en: B. Sellers under the Feed Management Act

rows.source_ko: 9. 가축분뇨를 수집ㆍ운반하는 사람
rows.text_en: 9. Persons who collect and transport livestock manure

rows.source_ko: 10. 「축산법」 제34조에 따른 가축시장의 종사자
rows.text_en: 10. Workers at livestock markets pursuant to Article 34 of the Livestock Act

rows.source_ko: 11. 「축산물위생관리법」 제2조제5호의 원유를 수집ㆍ운반하는 사람
rows.text_en: 11. Persons collecting or transporting raw milk under Article 2 , Subparagraph 5 of the Livestock Products Sanitation Management Act

rows.source_ko: 12. 도축장의 종사자
rows.text_en: 12. Slaughterhouse workers

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 수의ㆍ축산 관련 업무에 종사하여 가축전염병 예방을 위하여 질문ㆍ검사ㆍ소독 등 조치가 필요하다고 검역본부장이 정하여 고시하는 사람
rows.text_en: 13. Other persons engaged in veterinary or livestock-related duties whom the Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency designates and notifies as requiring measures such as questioning, inspection, and disinfection for the prevention of infectious animal diseases.

rows.source_ko: ② 검역본부장은 가축전염병 발생국에서 입국하는 사람이 해당 국가의 축산농가를 방문하였는지 여부를 세관장의 협조를 얻어 「관세법」 제241조제2항에 따라 관세청장이 정하여 고시하는 여행자(승무원) 세관신고서 등으로 확인할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2020. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director General of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency may, with the cooperation of the head of the customs office, verify whether a person entering from a country where an infectious animal disease has occurred has visited a livestock farm in that country using the traveler (crew) customs declaration form, etc. , prescribed and notified by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service pursuant to Article 241 , Paragraph 2 of the Customs Act . <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; May 28, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 「가축전염병 예방법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제2조의5에 따른 동물검역 신고서는 별지 제1호의4서식으로 한다. <개정 2014. 2. 14., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The animal quarantine report form pursuant to Article 2-5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Prevention of Infectious Diseases in Livestock (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be Form No. 1-4 of the Attached Form . <Amended Feb. 14, 2014; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ④ 검역본부장은 법 제5조제5항 및 같은 조 제6항에 따라 전염병발생국가에서 입국하는 사람 등에 대하여 소독을 실시하는 경우 별지 제1호의5서식에 따른 소독 확인증을 발급할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2018. 5. 1., 2020. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the Quarantine and Inspection Agency may issue a certificate of disinfection in accordance with Form No. 1-5 of the Attached Form when conducting disinfection on persons, etc. entering from a country with an outbreak of an infectious disease pursuant to Article 5, Paragraphs 5 and 6 of the Act . < Amended Mar. 23 , 2013 ; May 1, 2018; May 28, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 가축의 소유자등과 그 동거가족 등의 법 제5조제6항에 따른 입국ㆍ출국사실 등의 신고는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나의 방법에 의한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 2. 14., 2017. 5. 29., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The reporting of entry, exit, etc., by the owner, etc. of livestock and their cohabiting family members, etc., pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 6 of the Act shall be made by any one of the following methods: <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 14, 2014; May 29, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방역정보시스템을 통한 신고
rows.text_en: 1. Reporting through the disease control information system

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제1호의6서식에 따른 축산관계자 입국ㆍ출국 신고서를 작성하여 도착하거나 출발하는 항구, 공항 또는 그 밖의 장소에서 검역본부장에게 직접 제출하거나 팩스 등 전자문서로 제출
rows.text_en: 2. Complete the Entry/Exit Report for Livestock Personnel in accordance with Form No. 1-6 and submit it directly to the Head of the Animal Quarantine and Inspection Agency at the port of arrival, airport, or other place of departure, or submit it as an electronic document such as by fax.

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제1호의6서식에 따른 신고사항을 검역본부장에게 전화로 신고
rows.text_en: 3. Report the matters to be reported pursuant to Form No. 1-6 to the Head of the Quarantine and Inspection Agency by telephone.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 검역본부장은 법 제5조제5항 및 같은 조 제6항에 따라 제출받은 입국자 동물 검역신고서 및 축산관계자 입국ㆍ출국 신고서를 정보화 처리하고 정보기록매체 등에 수록하여 관리 및 유지할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 5. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of the Animal Quarantine and Inspection Agency may digitize and record in information media, etc., the animal quarantine declaration forms for entrants and the entry and exit declaration forms for livestock-related persons received pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 5 and Paragraph 6 of the Act, and manage and maintain them. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; May 29, 2017>

[This Article newly established July 25, 2011]
[Title amended May 29, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의5(방역관리 책임자) ① 법 제5조의2제1항 본문에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 규모 이상의 가축”이란 10만 마리 이상의 닭 또는 오리를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-5 (Person in Charge of Quarantine Management) ① In the main text of Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “livestock of a scale or larger as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to 100,000 or more chickens or ducks.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조의2제1항 본문에 따른 방역관리 책임자와 법 제5조의2제1항 단서에 따른 방역업체 및 방역전문가의 자격기준은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The qualification standards for the person in charge of disease control pursuant to the main text of Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , and for disease control companies and disease control experts pursuant to the proviso of Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 방역관리 책임자 및 방역전문가: 「고등교육법」 제2조에 따른 학교에서 수의학 또는 축산학 분야를 전공하고 졸업한 사람 또는 이와 동등 이상의 학력을 가진 사람으로서 해당 학력을 취득한 후 방역관련 분야에 3년 이상 종사한 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Disease Control Managers and Disease Control Experts: Persons who have majored in veterinary medicine or animal husbandry and graduated from a school pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act, or persons with equivalent or higher educational qualifications who have worked in a disease control-related field for at least three years after acquiring such qualifications.

rows.source_ko: 2. 방역업체: 제1호에 해당하는 사람을 2명 이상 고용한 업체
rows.text_en: 2. Pest control companies: Companies that employ two or more persons falling under Item 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 가축의 소유자등은 법 제5조의2제1항 단서에 따라 방역업체 및 방역전문가와 계약을 통하여 정기적으로 방역관리를 하는 경우에는 별지 제1호의7서식의 방역관리 인가신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where the owner, etc. of livestock under Paragraph 1 conducts regular disease control management through a contract with a disease control company and a disease control expert pursuant to the proviso of Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall submit an application for authorization of disease control management in the form of Annex 1-7 to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제2항 각 호의 자격을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents proving the qualifications specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업자등록증(방역업체인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Business Registration Certificate (applicable only to pest control companies)

rows.source_ko: 3. 정기적 방역관리에 관한 계약서
rows.text_en: 3. Contract regarding regular disease control management

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따른 신청서를 받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 사업자등록증을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증의 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The mayor, county governor, or district head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall verify the business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, the applicant shall be required to attach the document.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제5조의2제2항제4호에 따른 가축방역 관련 업무는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The duties related to livestock disease control pursuant to Article 5-2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 가축전염병 예방 및 진단을 위한 분뇨 수집 등 시료채취
rows.text_en: 1. Sampling, such as manure collection, for the prevention and diagnosis of livestock infectious diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제17조에 따른 소독설비 및 방역시설 기준 준수 및 이행 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Compliance with and implementation management of standards for disinfection facilities and disease control facilities pursuant to Article 17 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제17조의6에 따른 방역기준의 준수 및 이행 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of compliance with and implementation of disease prevention standards pursuant to Article 17-6 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 가축전염병 예방을 위하여 필요한 업무로서 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Other duties necessary for the prevention of livestock infectious diseases as determined and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제5조의2제3항에 따른 가축방역교육은 매년 4시간 이상으로 하며, 교육의 내용ㆍ방법 등 교육에 필요한 세부사항은 검역본부장이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Livestock disease control education pursuant to Article 5-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be at least 4 hours per year, and the details necessary for education, such as the content and methods of education, shall be determined and announced by the Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency .

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제1항에 따른 가축의 소유자등은 법 제5조의2제4항에 따라 방역관리 책임자를 선임하거나 해임하는 때에는 별지 제1호의8서식의 방역관리 책임자 선임(해임)신고서에 제2항제1호의 자격을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ When the owner, etc. of livestock pursuant to Paragraph 1 appoints or dismisses a person in charge of disease control pursuant to Paragraph 4 of Article 5-2 of the Act , they shall submit a report on the appointment (dismissal) of a person in charge of disease control in Form No. 1-8 of the attached document to the mayor, county governor, or district head, attaching documents proving the qualifications under Paragraph 2, Item 1.
[This Article Newly Inserted May 1, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의6(가축방역위생관리업의 신고) ① 법 제5조의3제1항 전단에 따라 가축방역위생관리업을 하려는 자가 갖추어야 하는 시설ㆍ장비 및 인력 기준은 별표 1의3과 같다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-6 (Reporting of Livestock Disease Control and Sanitation Management Business) ①The standards for facilities, equipment, and personnel required of a person intending to engage in the livestock disease control and sanitation management business pursuant to the first part of Article 5-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Annex 1-3 . <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조의3제1항 전단에 따라 가축방역위생관리업을 하려는 자는 별지 제1호의9서식의 가축방역위생관리업 신고서에 시설ㆍ장비ㆍ인력 명세서 및 운영계획서를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2026. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to engage in the livestock disease control and hygiene management business pursuant to the first part of Article 5-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a report on the livestock disease control and hygiene management business in the form of Annex 1-9, attached with a detailed list of facilities, equipment, and personnel and an operation plan, to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head. <Amended Apr. 23, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항에 따라 신고를 수리(受理)했을 때에는 별지 제1호의10서식의 가축방역위생관리업 신고증을 신고자에게 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the mayor, county governor, or district head accepts a report pursuant to paragraph 2, he/she shall issue a livestock disease control and hygiene management business report certificate in the form of Annex 1-10 to the reporter.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의7(신고사항의 변경) ① 법 제5조의3제1항에 따라 가축방역위생관리업의 신고를 한 자(이하 “방역위생관리업자”라 한다)가 같은 항 후단에 따라 신고사항을 변경하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의11서식의 가축방역위생관리업 신고사항 변경신고서에 가축방역위생관리업 신고증과 변경사항을 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-7 (Change of Reported Matters) ①If a person who has reported livestock disease control and hygiene management business pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “disease control and hygiene management business operator”) intends to change the reported matters pursuant to the latter part of the same paragraph, he/she must submit a report on the change of reported matters for livestock disease control and hygiene management business in the form of Annex 1-11 to the mayor, county governor, or district head, attaching the certificate of report for livestock disease control and hygiene management business and documents proving the changes.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 변경신고를 받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신고사항을 가축방역위생관리업 신고증 뒤쪽에 적어 이를 신고자에게 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor, county governor, or district head who receives a report of change pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall record the reported details on the back of the livestock disease control and hygiene management business report and issue it to the reporter.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의8(가축방역위생관리업의 휴업 등의 신고) ① 법 제5조의3제2항에 따라 휴업ㆍ폐업 또는 재개업을 신고하려는 방역위생관리업자는 별지 제1호의12서식의 신고서(전자문서를 포함한다)에 가축방역위생관리업 신고증을 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-8 (Reporting of Suspension, etc. of Livestock Disease Control and Hygiene Management Business) ①A disease control and hygiene management business operator who intends to report suspension, closure, or resumption of business pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a report form (including electronic documents) in accordance with Form No. 1-12 of the Appendix, attached with the certificate of registration of the livestock disease control and hygiene management business, to the mayor, county governor, or district head.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 「부가가치세법 시행령」 제13조제5항에 따라 관할 세무서장이 송부한 제1항의 신고서를 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 접수한 경우에는 제1항에 따라 신고서를 제출한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if the competent mayor, county governor, or district head receives the report under Paragraph 1 sent by the competent tax office pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Value Added Tax Act, it shall be deemed that the report has been submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 신고서를 접수한 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신고사항을 가축방역위생관리업 신고증 뒤쪽에 적어 이를 신고자에게 발급해야 한다. 다만, 폐업신고의 경우에는 발급하지 않는다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head who receives the report form pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 shall record the reported details on the back of the Livestock Disease Control and Sanitation Management Business Report Certificate and issue it to the reporter. However, it shall not be issued in the case of a report of business closure.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의9(소독ㆍ방제의 기준 및 기록 등) ① 법 제5조의3제4항에 따른 소독ㆍ방제의 기준과 방법은 별표 1의4와 같다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-9 (Standards and Records, etc. for Disinfection and Pest Control) ①The standards and methods for disinfection and pest control pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be as set forth in Table 1-4 . <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조의3제4항에 따라 소독 또는 방제를 실시한 방역위생관리업자는 별지 제1호의13서식의 소독ㆍ방제증명서를 소독 또는 방제를 실시한 시설의 관리ㆍ운영자에게 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A disease control and hygiene management business operator who has carried out disinfection or pest control pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall issue a certificate of disinfection and pest control in the form of Annex 1-13 to the manager or operator of the facility where the disinfection or pest control was carried out.

rows.source_ko: ③ 방역위생관리업자는 법 제5조의3제4항에 따라 별지 제1호의14서식의 소독ㆍ방제실시대장에 소독ㆍ방제에 관한 사항을 기록하고, 이를 2년간 보존해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ A disease control and hygiene management business operator shall record matters concerning disinfection and pest control in the disinfection and pest control implementation ledger in the form of Annex 1-14 pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 4 of the Act , and preserve it for two years.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의10(행정처분의 기준) 법 제5조의3제6항에 따른 행정처분의 세부 기준은 별표 1의5와 같다. <개정 2020. 5. 28., 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-10 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions) The detailed standards for administrative dispositions pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 6 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1-5 . <Amended May 28, 2020; Oct. 7, 2020>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의11(방역위생관리업자 등에 대한 교육) ① 방역위생관리업자(법인인 경우에는 그 대표자를 말한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)는 가축방역위생관리업의 신고를 한 날부터 6개월 이내에 법 제5조의4제1항 및 제2항에 따라 별표 1의6의 교육과정에 따른 소독 및 방제에 관한 교육을 받아야 한다. <개정 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-11 (Education for Disease Control and Sanitation Management Operators, etc.) ① A disease control and sanitation management operator (in the case of a corporation, its representative; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) shall receive education on disinfection and pest control in accordance with the educational curriculum set forth in Annex 1-6, pursuant to Article 5-4, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Act, within six months from the date of filing the report on the livestock disease control and sanitation management business. <Amended Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 방역위생관리업자는 고용한 소독 및 방제업무 종사자(이하 “소독 및 방제업무 종사자”라 한다)에게 해당 업무에 종사한 날부터 6개월 이내에 소독 및 방제에 관한 교육을 받게 해야 하고, 이후에는 직전의 교육을 받은 연도의 다음 연도 12월 31일까지 매년 1회 이상 보수교육을 받게 해야 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② A disease control and hygiene management business operator shall ensure that employees engaged in disinfection and pest control work (hereinafter referred to as “employees engaged in disinfection and pest control work”) receive training regarding disinfection and pest control within six months from the date they began performing the relevant work, and thereafter, receive refresher training at least once a year by December 31 of the year following the year in which the previous training was received. <Amended Apr. 23, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제5조의4제4항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 소독 및 방제업무 전문기관 또는 단체”란 다음 각 호의 단체를 말한다. <개정 2026. 4. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 5-4, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “specialized institutions or organizations for disinfection and pest control duties prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the organizations listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Apr. 23, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방역본부
rows.text_en: 1. Disease Control Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 2. 「수의사법」 제23조에 따라 설립된 대한수의사회(이하 “수의사회”라 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. The Korean Veterinary Medical Association established pursuant to Article 23 of the Veterinarians Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Veterinary Medical Association”)

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 교육에 필요한 경비는 교육을 받는 자가 부담한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The expenses necessary for the education under Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be borne by the person receiving the education.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(가축방역교육 실시 등) ①법 제6조제2항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 축산 관련 단체”란 다음 각 호의 단체(이하 “축산관련단체”라 한다)를 말한다. <개정 2006. 5. 8., 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 12. 30., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 2. 14., 2015. 2. 27., 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Implementation of Livestock Disease Control Education, etc.) ① In Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the term “livestock-related organizations prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the organizations listed in each of the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as “livestock-related organizations”). <Amended May 8, 2006; March 3, 2008; December 30, 2010; March 23, 2013; February 14, 2014; February 27, 2015; July 1, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방역본부
rows.text_en: 1. Disease Control Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 2. 「농업협동조합법」에 의한 농업협동조합중앙회(농협경제지주회사를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. National Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives (including Nonghyup Economic Holding Company) pursuant to the Agricultural Cooperatives Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 수의사회
rows.text_en: 3. Veterinary Association

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 가축방역업무에 필요한 조직과 인원을 갖춘 축산과 관련되는 단체로서 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 단체
rows.text_en: 4. Other livestock-related organizations equipped with the organization and personnel necessary for livestock disease control work, as designated and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

rows.source_ko: ②법 제6조제1항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 가축의 소유자와 그에게 고용된 사람”이란 다음 각 호의 자를 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 12. 30., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the phrase “owners of livestock prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and persons employed by them” refers to any of the persons listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Dec. 30, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 50제곱미터 이상의 소ㆍ돼지ㆍ닭ㆍ오리ㆍ사슴ㆍ면양 또는 산양의 사육시설을 갖추고 있는 해당 가축의 소유자와 그에게 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: 1. The owner of the relevant livestock who possesses a breeding facility for cattle, pigs, chickens, ducks, deer, sheep, or goats of 50 square meters or more, and a person employed by him/her.

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 농림축산식품부장관 또는 지방자치단체의 장이 가축전염병이 발생하거나 퍼지는 것을 막기 위하여 가축방역교육이 필요하다고 인정하는 가축의 소유자 또는 그에게 고용된 사람
rows.text_en: 2. Other owners of livestock or persons employed by them whom the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government deems necessary to provide livestock disease control education to prevent the occurrence or spread of infectious livestock diseases.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(가축방역교육의 지원 등) ①농림축산식품부장관 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 법 제6조제2항에 따라 가축방역교육을 실시하는 축산관련단체에 예산의 범위안에서 교육교재의 편찬, 강사수당 등 가축방역교육에 소요되는 경비를 지원할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 2. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Support for Livestock Disease Control Education, etc.) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government may, within the limits of the budget, provide support for expenses required for livestock disease control education, such as the compilation of educational materials and lecturer allowances, to livestock-related organizations conducting such education pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act. < Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 14, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ②그 밖에 교육시간ㆍ교육교재편찬ㆍ교육실시결과보고 등 가축방역교육에 관하여 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Other matters necessary for livestock disease control education, such as education hours, compilation of educational materials, and reporting of education implementation results, shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs . <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(가금 축산계열화사업자의 방역관리) ① 법 제6조의2제1항 전단에서 “휴업 등 농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 정당한 사유”란 다음 각 호의 사유를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Disease Control Management of Poultry Industry Vertical Integration Business Operators) ① The term “justifiable reasons prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, such as suspension of business” in the first part of Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to the reasons set forth in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 30일 이상 휴업하는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In case of business suspension for 30 days or more

rows.source_ko: 2. 재해, 질병 또는 사고 등 예측하지 못한 사유로 위탁 사육이 사실상 불가능한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where entrusted rearing is practically impossible due to unforeseen circumstances such as disasters, diseases, or accidents

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제6조의2제1항 전단에서 “가축의 사육, 운송, 도축 등 농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 단계”란 가축의 사육, 운송, 도축 단계를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In the first part of Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the phrase “stages prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, such as the rearing, transportation, and slaughter of livestock” refers to the stages of rearing, transportation, and slaughtering of livestock.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제6조의2제1항 전단에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 내용”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In the first part of Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “contents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to matters classified according to each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 가축의 사육
rows.text_en: 1. Rearing of livestock

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제17조의3제1항에 따른 축산관계시설(이하 “축산관계시설”이라 한다) 출입 차량 및 사람에 대한 소독ㆍ출입통제 등 차단방역 실시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters concerning the implementation of quarantine measures, such as disinfection and access control, for vehicles and persons entering livestock-related facilities (hereinafter referred to as “livestock-related facilities”) pursuant to Article 17-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「축산계열화사업에 관한 법률」 제2조제6호에 따른 계약사육농가(이하 “계약사육농가”라 한다)에 대한 방역교육 실시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: B. Matters concerning the implementation of disease prevention education for contract breeding farms pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 6 of the Act on the Vertical Integration of Livestock Business (hereinafter referred to as “contract breeding farms”)

rows.source_ko: 다. 법 제17조의6제1항에 따른 방역기준 및 「축산법」 제22조에 따른 축산업 허가ㆍ등록 기준의 준수 점검 및 개선조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: C. Matters concerning inspections of compliance with disease control standards pursuant to Article 17-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act and standards for livestock business licensing and registration pursuant to Article 22 of the Livestock Act, and corrective measures

rows.source_ko: 2. 가축의 운송
rows.text_en: 2. Transport of livestock

rows.source_ko: 가. 제1호가목의 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters under Subparagraph 1(a)

rows.source_ko: 나. 법 제17조제12항에 따른 가축운반차량의 분뇨 유출 방지 조치 및 분뇨 유출 시 필요한 조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: B. Matters concerning measures to prevent manure leakage from livestock transport vehicles pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 12 of the Act and measures necessary in the event of manure leakage

rows.source_ko: 다. 법 제17조의3제1항에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 등록하여야 하는 차량(이하 “시설출입차량”이라 한다)의 등록 및 같은 조 제4항에 따른 시설출입차량의 등록 여부 확인에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: C. Matters concerning the registration of vehicles required to be registered with the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head pursuant to Article 17-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “vehicles entering or exiting facilities”) and the verification of registration status of such vehicles pursuant to Paragraph 4 of the same Article

rows.source_ko: 라. 법 제17조의3제2항, 제3항 및 제6항에 따른 차량무선인식장치의 장착, 정상 작동 관리, 기능 준수에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: D. Matters concerning the installation, management of normal operation, and compliance with functions of vehicle radio identification devices pursuant to Article 17-3 , Paragraphs 2, 3 , and 6 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 가축의 도축
rows.text_en: 3. Slaughter of livestock

rows.source_ko: 가. 제1호가목의 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters under Subparagraph 1(a)

rows.source_ko: 나. 법 제17조제1항에 따른 소독설비 및 방역시설 기준 준수에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: B. Matters concerning compliance with standards for disinfection facilities and disease control facilities pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 「축산물 위생관리법」 제8조에 따른 위생관리기준 준수에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: C. Matters concerning compliance with hygiene management standards pursuant to Article 8 of the Livestock Products Hygiene Management Act

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제6조의2제1항 전단에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 중요한 사항”이란 가축의 사육, 운송, 도축 단계에서의 축산관계시설 출입 차량 및 사람에 대한 소독ㆍ출입통제 등 차단방역 실시에 관한 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In the first part of Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to matters concerning the implementation of quarantine measures, such as disinfection and entry control for vehicles and people entering livestock-related facilities at the stages of raising, transporting, and slaughtering livestock.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 검역본부장, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 특별자치시장은 법 제6조의2제3항에 따라 소속 공무원으로 하여금 출입하여 조사하게 할 수 있다. 이 경우 출입 또는 조사를 하는 공무원은 그 권한을 표시하는 증표를 지니고 이를 관계인에게 내보여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Quarantine Agency, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City may have officials under their jurisdiction enter and conduct an investigation pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act . In this case, the official conducting the entry or investigation must carry an identification card indicating their authority and present it to the persons concerned.

[This Article was newly added on Apr. 23, 2026.]
[Formerly Article 9-2 was moved to Article 9-3 <April 23, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의3(계약사육농가에 대한 방역교육 실시 등) ① 법 제6조의3제1항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 교육내용”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-3 (Implementation of disease prevention education for contract farming households, etc.) ① The term “educational content prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 6-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 가축질병 위기관리 매뉴얼
rows.text_en: 1. Livestock Disease Crisis Management Manual

rows.source_ko: 2. 가축의 소유자등이 준수해야 하는 방역기준
rows.text_en: 2. Disease control standards that livestock owners, etc. must comply with

rows.source_ko: 3. 차단방역 및 소독시설 설치ㆍ운영 방법
rows.text_en: 3. Methods for Installing and Operating Quarantine and Disinfection Facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 구제역 또는 고병원성 조류인플루엔자 임상예찰 및 신고 방법
rows.text_en: 4. Clinical Surveillance and Reporting Methods for Foot-and-Mouth Disease or Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza

rows.source_ko: 5. 외국인근로자가 준수하여야 할 방역수칙
rows.text_en: 5. Quarantine guidelines that foreign workers must observe

rows.source_ko: 6. 구제역 백신 접종 방법[우제류(偶蹄類: 소, 돼지, 양, 염소 및 사슴 등과 같이 발굽이 둘로 갈라진 동물) 계약사육농가만 해당한다]
rows.text_en: 6. Foot-and-Mouth Disease Vaccination Method [Applicable only to contract farms raising cloven-hoofed animals (animals with cloven hooves such as cattle, pigs, sheep, goats, and deer)]

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 농림축산식품부장관이 필요하다고 인정하여 고시한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs as deemed necessary

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제6조의3제1항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 교육주기”란 분기별 1회 이상을 말한다. 다만, 계약사육농가가 「축산법」 제33조의3제1항에 따라 지정된 교육운영기관에서 교육과정을 이수한 경우 「축산계열화사업에 관한 법률」 제2조제5호에 따른 축산계열화사업자(이하 “축산계열화사업자”라 한다)가 계약사육농가에 대하여 해당 연도의 교육을 실시한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 6-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “education cycle prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to at least once per quarter. However, if a contract breeding farmer has completed an educational course at an educational operating institution designated pursuant to Article 33-3, Paragraph 1 of the Livestock Act, the livestock vertical integration business operator pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act on the Vertical Integration of Livestock Business (hereinafter referred to as the “livestock vertical integration business operator”) shall be deemed to have conducted the education for the relevant year for the contract breeding farmer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 축산계열화사업자는 법 제6조의3제2항에 따라 계약사육농가에 대하여 분기별 1회 이상 방역기준 및 축산업 허가ㆍ등록 기준 준수 여부를 점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In accordance with Article 6-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act , a livestock vertical integration business operator must inspect contract farming households at least once a quarter to check compliance with disease prevention standards and livestock business permit and registration standards.

rows.source_ko: ④ 축산계열화사업자는 법 제6조의3제3항에 따라 매분기 종료 후 5일 이내에 계약사육농가에 대한 교육실시 및 점검ㆍ개선조치 결과(제2항 단서에 따른 「축산법」 제33조의3제1항에 따라 지정된 교육운영기관에서의 교육과정 이수 여부를 포함한다)를 계약사육농가의 소재지를 관할하는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통지(전자적 방식의 통지를 포함한다)해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ A livestock vertical integration business operator shall, in accordance with Article 6-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , notify the mayor, county governor, or district head having jurisdiction over the location of the contract livestock farm of the results of the education implementation and inspection and improvement measures for the contract livestock farm (including whether the education course at the education operating institution designated pursuant to Article 33-3, Paragraph 1 of the Livestock Act pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 2) within 5 days after the end of each quarter (including notification by electronic means).

rows.source_ko:
[전문개정 2026. 4. 23.]
[제9조의2에서 이동, 종전 제9조의3은 제9조의4로 이동 <2026. 4. 23.>]
rows.text_en:
[Wholly Amended Apr. 23, 2026]
[Moved from Article 9-2; former Article 9-3 moved to Article 9-4 <April 23, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의4(가축방역관에 대한 교육 실시 등) 법 제7조제5항에 따른 가축방역관의 교육은 매년 4시간 이상으로 하며, 교육의 내용ㆍ방법 등 교육에 필요한 세부사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하는 바에 따른다. <개정 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-4 (Implementation of Training for Animal Quarantine Officers, etc.) The training for animal quarantine officers pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 5 of the Act shall be at least four hours annually, and detailed matters necessary for such training, such as the content and methods of training, shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs . <Amended July 1, 2019>

[This Article was newly added on May 1, 2018]
[Moved from Article 9-3 on April 23, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(가축방역사) ①법 제8조제4항에 따라 가축방역사로 위촉할 수 있는 사람은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람으로 한다. <개정 2006. 5. 8., 2011. 7. 25., 2017. 1. 2., 2024. 11. 26., 2026. 9. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Livestock Disease Control Officer) ① Persons who may be appointed as livestock disease control officers pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 8, 2006; July 25, 2011; Jan. 2, 2017; Nov. 26, 2024; Sep. 29, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국가기술자격법」에 의한 축산산업기사 이상의 자격이 있는 사람
rows.text_en: 1. A person holding a qualification of Livestock Industry Engineer or higher under the National Technical Qualifications Act

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 「수의사법」 제16조의2에 따른 동물보건사의 자격이 있는 사람
rows.text_en: 1-2. A person qualified as an animal health technician pursuant to Article 16-2 of the Veterinarian Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「고등교육법」에 의한 전문대학 이상의 대학에서 수의학ㆍ축산학ㆍ생물학 또는 보건학 분야를 전공하고 졸업한 자(졸업예정자를 포함한다) 또는 법령에 따라 이와 같은 수준 이상의 학력이 있다고 인정되는 사람
rows.text_en: 2. Persons who have majored in and graduated from a junior college or higher-level school under the Higher Education Act in the fields of veterinary medicine, animal husbandry, biology, or public health (including prospective graduates), or persons recognized by relevant laws and regulations as having an equivalent or higher level of education.

rows.source_ko: 3. 국가ㆍ지방사람치단체 및 영 제3조제1항에 따른 행정기관에서 가축방역업무를 6월 이상 수행한 경험이 있는 사람
rows.text_en: 3. Persons with experience performing livestock disease control duties for at least six months at the national or local governments and administrative agencies pursuant to Article 3 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree.

rows.source_ko: 4. 축산관련단체에서 가축방역에 관한 업무에 1년 이상 종사한 경험이 있는 사람
rows.text_en: 4. Persons with at least one year of experience working in livestock disease control at a livestock-related organization

rows.source_ko: ②농림축산식품부장관 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 제1항에 따른 가축방역사의 자격을 갖춘 사람 중 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기관이 실시하는 24시간 이상의 교육과정을 이수한 사람을 가축방역사로 위촉한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 23., 2026. 9. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government shall appoint as livestock disease control officers any person who possesses the qualifications of a livestock disease control officer pursuant to Paragraph 1 and has completed a training course of at least 24 hours conducted by an institution falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Sep. 29, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방역본부
rows.text_en: 1. Disease Control Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 2. 농림축산식품부장관이 지정하는 소속기관
rows.text_en: 2. Affiliated organizations designated by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

rows.source_ko: ③법 제8조제2항의 규정에 의한 가축방역사의 업무범위는 다음 각호와 같다. <개정 2011. 7. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The scope of duties of a livestock disease control officer pursuant to the provisions of Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended July 25, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 1. 가축방역관의 지도ㆍ감독을 받아 가축시장 또는 가축사육시설에 들어가 가축의 소유자등에 대하여 행하는 가축방역에 관한 질문
rows.text_en: 1. Questions regarding livestock disease control asked of livestock owners, etc., upon entering a livestock market or livestock breeding facility under the guidance and supervision of a livestock disease control officer

rows.source_ko: 2. 가축방역관의 지도ㆍ감독을 받아 가축시장ㆍ가축사육시설 또는 도축장에 들어가 가축질병 예찰에 필요한 시료의 채취
rows.text_en: 2. Entering livestock markets, livestock breeding facilities, or slaughterhouses under the guidance and supervision of a livestock quarantine officer to collect samples necessary for livestock disease surveillance

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 법 제7조제3항의 규정에 따라 가축방역관이 행하는 업무의 보조
rows.text_en: 3. Other assistance in the duties performed by livestock quarantine officers pursuant to the provisions of Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ④농림축산식품부장관 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 가축방역사로 하여금 제3항 각 호의 업무를 수행하게 하려면 미리 그 상대방에게 구두ㆍ서면 또는 전자문서로 알려야 한다. <개정 2008. 2. 5., 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government intends to have a livestock disease control officer perform the duties set forth in each subparagraph of Paragraph 3, they shall notify the other party in advance by oral, written, or electronic document. <Amended Feb. 5, 2008; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ⑤농림축산식품부장관 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 가축방역사의 업무수행을 위하여 예산의 범위안에서 수당을 지급할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government may pay allowances to livestock disease control officers for the performance of their duties within the limits of the budget. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(방역본부에 대한 보고지시 및 감독) ①농림축산식품부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제9조제9항에 따라 같은 조 제6항 각 호의 사업에 관한 사업실적을 보고하게 할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2012. 2. 8., 2013. 3. 23., 2020. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Reporting Instructions and Supervision of Quarantine Headquarters) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Governor of a City or Province may require a report on business performance regarding the projects listed in each subparagraph of Paragraph 6 of the Act , pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 9 of the Act . <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Feb. 8, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 7, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ②농림축산식품부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제9조제9항에 따라 관계공무원으로 하여금 방역본부가 같은 조 제6항 각 호의 사업을 적정하게 수행하고 있는지 여부를 감독하게 할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2012. 2. 8., 2013. 3. 23., 2020. 10. 7.>
